content: Ma huɗa tlǝri ɓagamnd nǝmnd ǝmtaɗ dǝ Daadamazhigǝla, kǝm ghala kuuramǝn tlamkǝnatlǝg kǝ herǝrra Daadamazhigǝlna, ɗuuwamars bi nal ba gyagyaan biya.

Cinngamcinng kǝ dǝgiti aa taag Daadamazhigǝla, amaa, “Sǝghǝv ba sarta kwa ɓagankur nai kǝ herǝrra, cinngankuranacinnga. Sǝghǝv ba sarta katǝga, mǝlankurumǝlǝga.” Cinngamcinnga! kwan sarta kwam da caaug nǝ uuram kǝ herǝrra Daadamazhigǝla, hiinan faciya katǝga!
Niyamal bi kǝ ɗuula mbǝɗǝg aanji kǝ war biya, aɗaba haik tlǝkǝna ɗuula ghudǝkiyamǝs ǝlbǝg tǝghǝr kǝ tlramiyama.

Dlakulvakwaha, baɗǝm nǝ dǝgiti kiiym ɓag nǝ miiyama, ɓagyamɓaga mbakyarvad kiiyam mardan takiya kiiym lii ɓa tlǝra Daadamazhigǝla. Kiiyam ɓagan dǝ fa ǝrvǝdmahuɗa, ard huɓa dlaɗa, mbahǝlla, ard dlaɗa ndzǝgana.

Kalakǝmndakakalǝg nǝ uuda, ar ɓǝlkǝmdǝm dama guda bǝrfina, dlaɓa ar fakǝmdǝt nǝ uud kǝ vavǝrra ma sarta ciiga hǝnkala, ɓagamndaɓag kǝ tlǝr kwa juujig kǝ ndzǝɗamnda, hǝnamndu bi kǝ haar biya dlaɓa famndu bi kǝ kaff biya.

Tǝdvad hǝnkalamnd kwa cacuwana, ard sǝrgasǝrgamnda, ard fa ǝrviɗmahuɗamnda ard taa jiira, maramndamarǝg taakiya kǝm lii ɓa tlǝra Daadamazhigǝl tǝdvad shǝɗkw cacuwanacacuwana, ard waiyakǝvamnda ba jiijiira,
Ard ǝlbǝgamnda kwa ba jiijiira, ard ndzǝɗa Daadamazhigǝla. Kǝm mǝng dǝ jiira kwa iin wa band dǝgdǝva kwa kiiyam hǝkyǝg nǝ miiyam ma dǝva kaffa ard dǝva ghyǝɓa.

Fakǝmndaarafǝg nǝ uuda, dlaɓa vǝlakǝmndvǝlǝg nǝ uud kǝ dlaɗa, dlǝbakǝmdǝtdlǝbǝg nǝ uuda, dlaɓa bazdakǝmndabadzǝg nǝ uud kǝ ɗaaga. Nakǝmdadalnǝg nǝ uud kǝ lii taa fiida, bakǝvakwaha kǝm taa ba jiir nǝmnda.
Mandki sǝrkǝmnd bi nǝ uud biya, tambar sǝrkǝmndsǝrǝg nǝ uuda ba vaivaiya, Mandki kǝm ba tǝ duula ǝmtsǝga, iin wan kwana kǝm bad shifǝga. Ar vǝlkǝmnd dlaɗa, bakǝvakwaha ciiɓakǝmndabi nǝ uudi,

Ma huɗa dlaɗǝn vǝlakǝmnd nǝ uudna, fakǝmnda ba hwaɗaaga. Aanji ba kǝm maay dǝ dǝgit biya, bakǝvakwaha tlakǝnatlǝg nǝ uudah badyǝk kǝ hyahǝr tǝdvad kǝmnda. Mandki kǝm maay aanji ndau biya, mbats baɗǝm nǝ dǝgita ba dǝgamnda.
Kuuram uudaha Korintiyaha, shǝbamndkurvabi aanji ndauw biya, dlaɓa maramndadamarǝg nǝmnd taakiya kǝm waikurwaiga ba vaivaiya.
Au kǝmnd wa duuwamndkurars duuga, abi kuuram wa haiyamantbi dǝ kǝmnd ma ǝrvǝdmahuɗaru biya.
Ən taagkur kwan naiya band kwa taagtǝr nǝ Daad kǝ ǝlbǝg kǝ zarhaana, kuuram ndakwani am markǝmndadan kǝ waiyakǝvaruwa.
Haɗambi kǝ ghǝr dǝ lii maay gatǝg biya
Haɗambi kǝ ghǝr dǝ uudahi kwar maay gata Yaazhigǝl biya. Əndzǝgandzǝg nǝ uuda jiirjiir ba lapi dǝ dadda ɓa kǝlaadǝra? Nii auwa dzǝtǝrǝm paraka ard gurtli?
Tsaghwa shatanah nǝ Kǝristiya? Nii auwa dzǝtǝrǝm lii gata Yesu ard lii maay gata Yesu biyi?

Auwa dzǝtǝrǝm vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla ard hǝnnyaha ɓa ghǝlli? Kǝm vǝgya Daadamazhigǝl nǝmd kwa dǝ shifǝga. Band kwa tagaa Daadamazhigǝl taaki, “Ən da ndzǝgan ǝmtaɗ dǝ iitǝra, ǝn gwaiva ma iitǝra. Ən nal dlaɓa kǝ Daadamazhigǝlatǝrra, ar nal dlaɓ nǝ iitǝr kǝ uudahara.

Mbakyarvad kwaha asamasagal ma lii ar maay gata Yesu biya, wahamzhawahǝg kǝ ghǝraru dǝ iitǝra, am nǝ Yaazhǝgǝla. Haɗambi kǝ ghǝraru dǝgiti kwa maay cacuwana cacuwan biya, ǝn da haikurǝt tǝdvad kwan naiya am nǝ Daadamazhigǝla.
Ən da nǝg kǝ Daadaruwa, kuuram dlaɓ am nal kǝ zarhahar ghwalvaha ard ǝnghwasaha. Am nǝ Yaazhǝgǝl kwad ndzǝɗ baɗǝmma.”
